LUNELLE DREAM DIAL 2000 — Mission 01 Asset Pack

FILES
- mission01-master.jpg: approved full-page artwork; visual source of truth.
- drop-items-source.jpg: six falling-item source sheet supplied by the user.
- beauty-bag.jpg: reference crop for the catcher bag.
- playfield.jpg, timer-score.jpg, mission-instruction.jpg, etc.: reference crops only.
- hotspots.json: normalized gameplay/reference coordinates.

IMPORTANT
The JPEG source is flattened. Do not redraw the approved page in CSS. Use mission01-master.jpg as the visual base.
For the six falling objects, isolate them from drop-items-source.jpg into individual transparent assets (lip gloss, digital pet/keychain, CD, sunglasses, star, bow). Remove the white background cleanly while preserving pixel-art outlines and highlights.
The bag in mission01-master.jpg is also flattened. For movement, create an independent catcher layer by extracting/reconstructing only the bag region as needed, while keeping the static page visually identical.
